arya: Quick triage — onboarding Celadon11b (HF). Small eval shows high token-level drift on multilingual QA and a weird rotary magnitude drop in int4. Anyone available?
noel: can you paste converter cmd and a tiny example that reproduces?
arya: `python convert.py --model celadon11b --quant int4 --out /tmp/celadon-q4`
snippet: ```
WARN tokenizer.vocab_size=50260 (card:50259)
WARN rotary.scale_shape mismatch: model headwise=true, converter wrote shared
```
mina: two likely causes: 1) extra vocab entry (maybe homoglyph or invisible char) shifting indices; 2) rotary scale truncated during quant rule folding. Any sample tokenization diffs?
arya: failing input: "fiancé — où est le9tude?" (accent + em dash). fp16 tokens: [fiancé,  20	4,  où, ...] int4 tokens: [fianc, 20	4,  efbfd,  e9tude] (garbled).
noel: sounds like normalization/encoding mismatch. Converter should preserve `tokenizer.normalization`. We recently added a `--force-utf8` flag; did you use it?
arya: no. converter autodetected UTF-8 but didn't error on vocab_size mismatch.
mina: for the rotary issue: int4 quant path applies a per-head scale -> small-float fallback; if converter collapsed headwise->shared we lose per-head scale variety and KV cache phase diverges. Try re-run with `--preserve-rotary-headwise --preserve-eos` and `--tokenizer-normalize nfkc`.
arya: re-run quick: `python convert.py --model celadon11b --quant int4 --preserve-rotary-headwise --tokenizer-normalize nfkc --preserve-eos --out /tmp/celadon-q4b`
mini-bench (5k tokens):
```
fp16 ppl: 11.7
int4 default ppl: 13.4
int4 headwise+nfkc ppl: 11.8
```
noel: good recovery. For the vocab mismatch, run `tools/token_map --check-roundtrip /tmp/celadon-q4b` to find remapped ids.
ci-bot: triggered job 9965000010 for `tools/token_map --check-roundtrip` on /tmp/celadon-q4b. queued.
mina: long-term: add conversion preflight that compares HF card fields (vocab_size, normalization, rotary.per_head) and fails with suggested flags if mismatch. Also add a small accent+homoglyph fuzz corpus to tokenizer tests.
arya: created PR 4307 with preflight checks, updated converter docs, and added a model-card field `conversion_notes` capturing choices. linked tests.
noel: suggest adding a post-convert headwise-cosine check between fp16 and int4 keys for first 8 layers; if any head < 0.98 warn and require explicit override.
mina: I'll add that to CI. Also record `tokenizer_fingerprint` (sha256 of tokenizer.json + merges) into model metadata.
arya: bench results from ci-bot: token_map roundtrip found id 50259 remapped -> 50260 due to a zero-width no-break space in a few training samples. fixed roundtrip and re-ran.
noel: thanks. once PR merges we should re-run full longctx eval (8 seeds) and attention-alignment plots to confirm no head-level phase drift.
arya: agreed. tagging docs for model_onboard.md with a short checklist: check hf card fields, token roundtrip, preserve headwise rotary, record metadata.
mina: thanks team. I'll follow up on CI alerts if anything else shows up.
arya: thanks all :thumbsup:
